title: Agility chooses Nyobolt ultra-fast charging for Digit 5 humanoid
key_facts: Agility Robotics said on 15 Oct 2026 it is working with Nyobolt on a fast-recharge battery for its Digit 5 humanoid robot.
The companies claim it will let the robot work more than 20 hours in a 24-hour day.
The new battery delivers 90 minutes of runtime and charges in nine minutes, a 10:1 run-to-charge ratio against 2:1 for Digit 4.
Early access to Digit 5 with the Nyobolt battery begins in the first half of 2027, with availability rising over the following six to nine months.
Nyobolt, a Cambridge, UK company founded in 2019, reached a $1 billion valuation in May 2026 after raising $60 million.
Agility plans to go public by merging with special-purpose acquisition company Churchill Capital Corp XI.
quote_evidence: The technology will allow the robot to work more than 20 hours in a day, the companies claimed.

why_it_matters_hint: Battery downtime is a main limit on humanoid robots at work; faster charging would raise uptime.
